question: On a straight road, a bus is 30 km ahead of a car traveling in the same direction. After 3 hours, the car is 60 km ahead of the bus. If the speed of the bus is 42 km/h, then find the speed of the car.
solution:
**Given:**

On a straight road, a bus is 30 km ahead of a car traveling in the same direction. 

After 3 hours, the car is 60 km ahead of the bus. 

The speed of the bus is 42 km/h,

**Concept used:**

Relative speed in same direction = Speed of car - speed of the bus

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculations:**

Let the speed of the car be x

According to the question,

Relative speed = x - 42 km/h

Distance = 30 + 60 = 90 km

Now Speed of the car will be

⇒ x - 42 = 90/3

⇒ x - 42 = 30

⇒ x = 30 + 42 = 72 km/h

**∴ The speed of the car will be 72 km/h.**
